title: Equinix Colocation Availability

review.note: Reviewed all 33 country-group tables and 253 unique facility codes in the official Equinix colocation availability directory. Country headings and service-coverage text remain source-scoped. No operating IT capacity, coordinates, floor areas or available inventory are established by this table. Exact code/operator/country map links are proposals only.

count_boundary: Publisher-listed facility codes; not unique buildings, available inventory or a global census.
service_boundary: Coverage describes on-site service coverage, not utilization or available capacity.
rights: Extracted factual directory entries. Source publication rights remain with Equinix. Independent from the ODbL map catalog.
